requirements.evidence: All contract items are present: the three migrations (`database/migrations/2026_10_29_063325_create_totems_table.php`, `..._063326_create_totem_presets_table.php`, `..._063327_create_totem_preset_queue_table.php`), the command and actions (`app/Console/Commands/PairingCode.php:15`, `app/Actions/OpenTotemPairing.php:40`, `app/Actions/PairTotem.php:27` with transaction + `lockForUpdate`), HS256 tokens with every required claim (`app/Support/TotemToken.php:20-34`), the middleware checks and `claim ∩ current join` scope (`app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:31-52`), all three endpoints with the specified payloads/statuses (`app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemQueueController.php:27,61,77`), throttles and 429 rendering (`routes/api.php:8-13`, `bootstrap/app.php:30-34`), CORS (`config/cors.php`), config/env/test pins (`config/services.php:38-41`, `.env.example:11-12`, `phpunit.xml`), and the `entity` in the pairing response (`TotemAuthController.php:36-41`). Edge cases (400 format, uniform 401, 403, 404, 422 inactive/invalid, 429, CORS deny) are handled and tested.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes go through new actions and issuance reuses the existing action instead of duplicating its rules (`app/Http/Controllers/Api/TotemQueueController.php:91` calls `IssueTicket` with `TicketChannel::Totem`); mass assignment is defined deliberately with `#[Fillable]` (`app/Models/Totem.php:11`, `app/Models/TotemPreset.php:11`) and system-set codes use `forceFill` (`app/Actions/PairTotem.php:54`); the migrations are generated-style and reversible; docs are kept in sync (`docs/api/totem.md`, `docs/database-schema.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md:12`, `docs/ops/devops.md:123`); audit logging uses the project's audit channel (`app/Actions/OpenTotemPairing.php:29`), per `docs/ops/logging.md`.

security.evidence: Token verification is strict: constant-time `hash_equals`, `alg` pinned to HS256 (so `none` is rejected), `exp` and claim types validated, and the secret fails closed below 32 chars (`app/Support/TotemToken.php:56-69,104-112`). The middleware re-checks totem/preset activity and entity consistency and returns one uniform 401 (`AuthenticateTotem.php:31-45`); path entities are compared to the token, queues are resolved inside the token's entity, and the scope is the claim ∩ current join (`TotemQueueController.php:105-131`, `AuthenticateTotem.php:47-52`); login codes are not mass-assignable (`TotemPreset.php:6`). The only weakness found is that the new pairing throttle keys on `$request->ip()` while `trustProxies(at: '*')` trusts a client-supplied `X-Forwarded-For` (`AppServiceProvider.php:28`, `bootstrap/app.php:21`), so the bucket can be rotated (see issue).

tests.evidence: Six Pest files ship with the change and cover the requirements plus failure paths: pairing success/single-use, the no-oracle 401 set, malformed codes, token forgery/alg/expiry (`tests/Feature/Api/TotemTokenTest.php:32-49`), middleware revocation and entity mismatch, queue scope incl. late additions and detach (`TotemEndpointsTest.php:47-130`), inactive/out-of-scope/unknown queues, priorities, issuance and both 429s (`TotemEndpointsTest.php:188-255`), CORS allow/deny/preflight (`TotemCorsTest.php:10-38`), factories/relations/cascades (`TotemModelsTest.php:55`) and the command incl. unknown preset (`TotemPairingCodeCommandTest.php:69`). Coverage is slightly short of 5 because the `pairedTotem(0)` fixture is wrong (issue) and the documented `updated_at` side effect is unasserted.

simplicity.evidence: The change reuses existing code well: `IssueTicket` (`TotemQueueController.php:91`), Eloquent relations, Laravel's `RateLimiter`, CORS middleware, and rate-limit exceptions rather than new infrastructure; helpers are small. Two small duplications remain: the queue-id extraction appears in both `app/Actions/PairTotem.php:63` and `app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:47`, and the appearance override is an extra presentation layer (`TotemQueueController.php:144`) on top of the required JSON column.

readability.evidence: Names and structure are clear, methods are short and focused (`tokenEntity`, `issuableQueue`, `appearance` at `TotemQueueController.php:105-149`), defaults are constants (`:23-25`), docblocks state the security intent (`AuthenticateTotem.php:15-20`), and the tests read as specifications. Only nit-level issues: a redundant double input read and boolean guard (`TotemQueueController.php:82-84`) and a dead `?:` fallback (`AppServiceProvider.php:30`).

scope.evidence: Every file in the diff serves the totem task or the mandated docs: models/migrations/factories, the pairing command/actions, token support, middleware, controllers, routes, config/env/test pins, and the documentation updates required by `conventions.md` (`docs/api/totem.md`, `docs/database-schema.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/README.md`, `docs/business-rules.md`, `docs/ops/devops.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`). No unrelated refactors or features.

issues.explanation: `foreach (range(1, $queueCount) ...)` receives 0 in the queue-list test and PHP's `range(1, 0)` returns `[1, 0]`, so `pairedTotem(0)` actually creates two queues instead of none; that test passes only because it re-signs a token without them, and the helper is misleading for future use.

The 10/min pairing limiter keys on `$request->ip()`, but `trustProxies(at: '*')` treats a client-supplied `X-Forwarded-For` as authoritative, so an attacker can rotate the bucket and brute-force a 6-digit code within its 10-minute window; trust only the edge proxy or use a non-spoofable key.

The change documents that `TOTEM_JWT_SECRET` is not passed through `docker/compose.vps.yml`; unless that file (or an `env_file`) forwards it, the totem API will fail closed with a 500 on the VPS, so the deployment wiring should be part of the change.
`sha1((string) $request->bearerToken()) ?: $request->ip()` never falls back to the IP because `sha1('')` is a non-empty hash; the adjacent comment promises a fallback that cannot happen.

The priority is parsed by reading `$request->input('priority')` twice and the `is_bool` arm is redundant (`filter_var(true, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT)` yields `1`, which `TicketPriority::tryFrom()` already rejects); one read would be clearer.
`(int) env('TOTEM_JWT_TTL', 3600)` turns an empty `TOTEM_JWT_TTL=` into 0 instead of the documented 3600 default, which would issue already-expired tokens.
The preset queue-id mapping is duplicated; a single `TotemPreset::queueIds()` helper would keep the 'allowed queues' rule in one place and avoid the two paths diverging.
The test asserts the new `last_seen_at` but not that `updated_at` is left untouched, although `docs/api/totem.md` promises the latter; one extra assertion would pin that behavior.

review.summary: The change implements the totem BFF end to end: schema, models and factories, the pairing command/actions, a small HS256 JWT implementation, the auth and three data endpoints behind `totem.auth`, throttling, CORS, and the required docs and tests. It meets the task contract and project conventions with unusually complete failure-path coverage; the remaining findings are minor (a wrong zero-queue test fixture, a spoofable throttle key, VPS env wiring) plus nits, so I would approve after small fixes.
